title: Primus Megatron vs upstream main
scope: Current Megatron-LM bundled in Primus vs upstream NVIDIA/Megatron-LM origin/main.

integration.integration_model: third_party/Megatron-LM + Primus outer trainer / adapter / patches

highlights: Primus bumped the Megatron pin in the 2026-10 window (PR #1321) from d3528a21 (Core 0.16.0rc0) to the core_v0.19.2 release tag 4b4acac9 (Core 0.19.2).
After the bump the pin is 1011 commits behind upstream main (037b883c, Core 0.21.0), down from ~1662 before the bump.
Package dependency metadata (pyproject.toml, megatron/core/requirements.txt) is unchanged vs upstream; the main drift is API and capability movement.
Primus has a large Megatron integration layer directly coupled to upstream training, distributed, MoE, optimizer, and model internals.

dashboard_summary.headline: Megatron was bumped to the core_v0.19.2 release tag and is now 1011 commits behind upstream main (Core 0.21.0), with broad MFSDP, MoE, SSM/Hybrid, and inference drift remaining.
why_it_matters: The 2026-10 bump (PR #1321) realigned Primus to a tagged release (core_v0.19.2) and cut the gap from ~1662 to 1011 commits.
A meaningful gap to main (Core 0.19.2 -> 0.21.0) still remains across two upstream minor versions.
The tree diff is 2722 files; package dependency metadata is unchanged, so the main risk is API and capability drift.
Primus trainer, extensions, and patch layers depend on upstream training, distributed, MoE, and model internals.
feature_deltas: MFSDP v2: DP-outer gradient-reduction stream overlap, MXFP8-recompute unshard planes, recorded execution order
MoE: fused Triton batch-invariant unpermute, THD/sequence packing for NCCL EP, bit-exact sigmoid-MoE routing
SSM/Hybrid: FP32 GDP A_log/dt_bias, CuTeDSL chunkwise-CP compile, KDA hybrid layers with GLM two-stage gates
Inference: FlashInfer MXFP8 expert-weight refit, per-token NVFP4 CuTe-DSL MoE, disaggregated end-to-end inference
Optimizer: OptimizerConfig migration, RMSNorm-gamma weight decay, mHC precision controls, LayerShardedMuon streaming
dependency_deltas: pyproject.toml project dependencies are identical between the pin and upstream main (torch>=2.6.0, numpy, packaging>=24.2).
Source-declared Megatron Core version moved from 0.19.2 (pin) to 0.21.0 (main).
Canonical Primus pin recorded in primus/_thirdparty.lock as 4b4acac9.
integration_risks: Primus MegatronTrainer wraps megatron.training pretrain/initialize/arguments and core pipeline-parallel internals.
Primus Turbo extensions depend on transformer_engine spec provider, core enums, parallel_state, and MoE experts.
Primus patches a main-only DDP _post_param_sync fast path that is skipped on core_v0.19.2.
MFSDP v2, MoE/router, SSM/Hybrid, and inference upstream movement overlap with existing Primus patch surfaces.
